QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_34

question.text: IRR metrics for Category III AIFs are reported to SEBI on what frequency?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.2.1, IRR is to be reported to SEBI quarterly or monthly, similar to other periodic filings. The Trap: Annual/5-year/wind-up cadence is not what SEBI requires. Cross-Exam Context: Aligns with broader reporting cadence from Ch 5. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Automate IRR updates in the portfolio management system — manual computation is error-prone.
